messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING oncall (severity: high) - deployment failure detected for service=redwood-inference-api, env=prod-us-west. Canary error rate > 30% for text.generate. Root thread: 1752301234

maria: got the page, looking

alex: i'm awake, if you need a hand ping me

maria: thanks. quick summary: canary rollout for v2.14.0 started 2m ago. Canary % of traffic 5%. Errors spiked immediately - 500s from inference workers. No obvious OOM in k8s metrics.

beth: seeing `kv-cache miss` + `decode timeout` in worker logs, looks like model initialization is stalling for long requests

maria: copying logs snippet:
```
[2025-11-09T03:47:12Z] worker-3: model_load_time=18400ms name=opt-6.7b quant=4bit
[2025-11-09T03:47:15Z] worker-3: rpc timeout while waiting for kv init
[2025-11-09T03:47:16Z] proxy: upstream 10.0.5.8:5000 returned 504
```

alex: hmm model_load_time 18s is bad. Could be a change in lazy-load path in v2.14.0 where we changed dynamic chunking.

maria: rolling back canary now. deploy-bot, initiate rollback of canary traffic to v2.13.9 for us-west only.

deploy-bot: Received rollback command. Starting rollback: target=production-us-west scope=canary id=deploy-20251109-0716. Estimated time ~30s.

incident-bot: incident created: INC-20251109-02. Severity: high. Customer impact: increased 5xx on text.generate in us-west; affected hosted API customers, intermittent timeouts for streaming responses.

beth: also see tracing indicating a hot path that touches optimized kernels on worker-3, errors correlate with sequence length > 1024 requests

maria: alex, can you check kernel selection config for opt models in that build? Might be falling back to slow CPU path and timing out.

alex: on it. checking staging config diff...

pagerduty-bot: On-call escalation: maria acknowledged. Escalating to sre-lead after 10m if not resolved.

sre-lead: looped in. if rollback doesn't reduce errors in 2m, we'll flip kill-switch for generation endpoint and serve degraded text-only fallback model. Notify support to open tickets with impacted customers.

maria: rollback progress: traffic shifted from v2.14.0 -> v2.13.9 for canary (5% -> 0%). Confirming metrics...

beth: errors down to baseline within 45s of rollback, 5xx rate back to normal for canary hosts. Looks like rollback succeeded.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete for canary scope. No further automated rollouts will proceed for v2.14.0.

incident-bot: Incident update: mitigated by rollback. Still monitoring for any lingering requests.

alex: opened PR with quick revert to lazy-load change (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4821) - we'll gate re-release behind extended canary and perf tests for seq>1024.

maria: handing off to alex for postmortem and RCA. i'm going offline in 15 to catch sleep. Alex, please update incident doc and notify support.

alex: taking over oncall. I'll assemble timeline, collect logs from affected workers, and draft customer impact blurb.

sre-lead: good handoff. action items for alex: 1) collect failing request traces 2) confirm kernel/fallback path change 3) run expanded perf tests 4) schedule rollback if re-release happens without fixes.

beth: note for postmortem: consider adding threshold for model_load_time and failing fast in proxy to avoid long tail blocking.

alex: will do. incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. expected to resolve in incident tracker after RCA.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20251109-02 status=monitoring severity=high assignee=alex

maria: thanks everyone. :heart:

alex: ping me if anything else pops up, i'll post the postmortem draft in ~2h.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation cleared.

sre-lead: closing slack thread for now, keep updates in the incident doc.
